Download `Piper-*.dmg`, open it and drag Piper to Applications.

This build is not notarized by Apple. The first time you open it, macOS will
refuse; go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click
**Open Anyway** next to the message about Piper. Alternatively run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Piper.app` in Terminal.

Runs on macOS 13 Ventura or later, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
